subject: ReadyWell — implementation kickoff and handoff
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen@readywell.io>, Marco Reyes <marco.reyes@readywell.io>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ReadyWell — implementation kickoff and handoff

Team — quick handoff note for ReadyWell (summary below). I’ll stay involved through initial milestones but want CS to own the execution.

Deal summary:
- Account: ReadyWell (healthtech scheduling platform)
- ARR: $240k/year (annualized)
- Committed start: 2027-05-10 (pilot), full roll by 2027-07-01
- Primary contacts: Ellen Park (Head of Ops), Marco Reyes (CTO), procurement@readywell.io

Key deliverables they expect from Redwood CS:
1) SSO (SAML) integration + SCIM provisioning ready for pilot
2) Data ingestion pipeline for anonymized scheduling logs (S3 pull)
3) Guardrails and token/usage dashboards for 3 pilot teams
4) Production readiness checklist and 30/60/90 ramp plan

Known constraints / risks:
- They require SOC2 evidence and a signed term sheet by this week for internal approvals.
- Data residency: US only, but they want confirmation on region mapping.
- Limited internal infra team availability the week of 4/26 — need to front-load config work.

Requests for CS team (please action):
- Stephanie: take overall PM/owner for onboarding and kickoff scheduling.
- Tessa: be the primary implementation lead for SSO and ingestion pipeline (technical owner).
- Vivek: can you approve reuse of a small dev pool for the pilot (2 GPUs reserved) and confirm SLA exceptions?

Attachments: RDW_SOW_v1.docx (SOW draft), term_sheet_readywell_signed.pdf (term sheet we just got), procurement_requirements.pdf (from Ellen, attached).

Next immediate steps:
- Internal sync (30m) by EOD Mon 4/19 to align owners and timeline.
- Send customer kickoff invite for 4/23 if owners confirmed.

Ben
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RDW_SOW_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]
[Attachment: term_sheet_readywell_signed.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ReadyWell — implementation kickoff and handoff

Thanks for the concise summary, Ben — excited to take point. A few quick clarifying questions so I can draft the 30/60/90 and kickoff agenda: 

1) Pilot scope: which of the three pilot teams get full telemetry vs. sampled data? Need names of pilot team leads (customer-side) so we can add them to the kickoff.
2) SSO timing: do they expect SAML before the pilot start (5/10) or is it acceptable as a post-pilot item?
3) Region confirmation: I will confirm with infra, but Ben, can you forward the customer's internal note that mentions \"US-only\" for data? I want to include the exact phrasing in the runbook.

I'll plan to own the kickoff invite + agenda and then hand primary technical activities to Tessa. Tessa — if you can share a short checklist for SSO and data ingestion (3–5 items) by EOD Mon 4/19, I'll slot them into the timeline.

Also — procurement: Ben, please introduce procurement contact to our finance team or loop in procurement@readywell.io so we can get the PO/terms finalized. The term sheet looks fine, want to make sure procurement sees the SOW draft.

I'll set internal sync for Mon 4/19 11:00am PT unless someone objects.

Steph
Senior Manager, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

Cc: Marco Reyes <marco.reyes@readywell.io>, Procurement <procurement@readywell.io>
Date: 2027-04-18T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ReadyWell — implementation kickoff and handoff

Hi Steph/Ben — thanks for the update and great to meet you virtually. Quick answers below: 

- Pilot teams: Ops QA, Scheduling Integrations, and Mobile Product (leads: Nat Li, Rajiv Sinha, and Priya Mehta). Ops QA needs full telemetry; the other two need sampled logs.
- SSO: we’d like SAML in place for pilot if possible — our security team prefers not to rely on password invites during pilot.
- Data residency: correct — all customer data must remain in US regions; our legal team will want the region mapping clarified in the runbook.

Looping in procurement@readywell.io for PO/terms. Procurement attached a short list of vendor requirements — see procurement_requirements.pdf.

We can make the week of 4/26 lighter on infra tasks if you front-load configuration this week. Appreciate the clear owners.

Ellen Park
Head of Operations | ReadyWell

Thanks everyone — I reviewed the SOW and term sheet. Approving allocation of a small dev pool for the pilot (2x A10s reserved through 7/15) and OK to proceed with SAML as an early priority.

Tessa — you're assigned as lead for implementation. Please share a 2-week micro-plan by EOD Tue 4/20 that covers:
- SAML integration milestones (dev/test/prod checkpoints)
- Ingestion plan for Ops QA (full telemetry) vs sampled logs

Steph — once Tessa's micro-plan is in, schedule the customer kickoff for 4/23 10am PT and include pilot team leads (Nat, Rajiv, Priya). Ben — please confirm procurement loop-in and that finance has what they need.

Vivek
